description: This file contains the implementation of a factory class 'ProducerPropertiesFactory' responsible for creating Kafka producer properties based on a given connection and Kafka configuration. It includes methods for configuring security protocols, client metadata, and converting configuration data into the appropriate format for Kafka producers.

classes.name: ProducerPropertiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating Kafka producer configuration properties from a Connection and KafkaConfig object.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of ProducerPropertiesFactory with the provided Connection and KafkaConfig.

methods.name: getProducerProperties
methods.description: Generates an unmodifiable map of Kafka producer properties based on the provided connection and Kafka configuration.

methods.name: addMetadata
methods.description: Adds client identification metadata to the producer properties, including connection ID and instance index.

methods.name: addSpecificConfig
methods.description: Applies specific Kafka configurations to the producer properties.

methods.name: addSecurityProtocol
methods.description: Configures the security protocol for the Kafka connection based on whether the connection is authenticated and secure.

methods.name: isConnectionAuthenticated
methods.description: Determines if the connection is authenticated by checking the applicable configuration.

methods.name: addAuthenticatedSecurityProtocol
methods.description: Sets security protocol to SASL_SSL or SASL_PLAINTEXT based on connection security when authenticated.

methods.name: addUnauthenticatedSecurityProtocol
methods.description: Sets security protocol to SSL or PLAINTEXT when the connection is unauthenticated.

methods.name: isConnectionSecure
methods.description: Checks if the connection protocol is 'ssl', indicating a secure connection.

methods.name: configToProperties
methods.description: Converts a Config object into a flat map of string keys and object values suitable for Kafka producer configuration.

methods.name: flattenUnwrappedConfig
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested unwrapped configuration map into a single level map with dot-separated keys.
